note: Gates that print a partition, and the artifact that summarises each. A summary quoting a total with no classes beside it is the failure PRO-0165 exists for: the total is true and the classes are two different jobs with two different owners. Add a row here when a gate starts printing a partition; partition_report.py reads the classes out of the gate's own output rather than recomputing them, so a class this file names and the gate stops printing is reported as a disagreement rather than silently dropped.
